look_here_first: Showy bladderpod relative with relatively large yellow flowers; it belongs in Paysonia rather than Physaria under the modern split.

key_traits.label: Family pattern
key_traits.text: Brassicaceae bladderpod group: 4-petaled yellow flowers, stellate hairs common, and inflated silicles/capsules; habit, hair density, pedicel posture, and fruit shape are important for ID.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: yellow flowers relatively large for the group

lookalikes.differences: The major learner cue here is taxonomic: this one is Paysonia, not Physaria. It is the 'bigflower' member of the old Lesquerella set.
